central_idea_and_construction: A friendly oval bakery emblem whose outer border has six large, shallow, softly scalloped lobes, like the edge of a paper pastry doily but very simplified. Inside, exact BREAD & BLOOM arranged as BREAD on the upper line, a modest & on its own short middle line, and BLOOM on the lower line. Use warm rounded flared-serif letters with open B/R counters, gently curved serifs and deliberate generous spacing. No tiny perimeter text. Two very small solid oval seed-like accents may sit left and right of the ampersand if they do not compete with lettering. A single solid strawberry-red ink; border and letters have related weights and ample gap. Emblem fills about 66% width, all type readable. No wheat wreath, ribbon, date, distressed stamp or engineering crest.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Soft scalloped outline and the two readable word lines.
specific_risk: Long words must not crowd the scallops or lose the ampersand.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
